get.description: Returns subject → topic → assignment breakdown of a student's graded submissions for a given academic term. Subject, topic, and overall averages use total points earned ÷ total points possible.

get.summary: Get assignment-level performance analytics for a student

parameters.description: UUID of the subject catalog entry

get.description: Teacher-scoped mirror of the school-admin class subject-performance endpoint. Class teachers may query any subject in the class; subject teachers may only query subjects they teach in that class. Returns every student with point-weighted aggregated score, rank, and performance cluster for a given subject and term.

parameters.name: subjectCatalogId
parameters.description: UUID of the subject catalog entry

parameters.name: aggregatedAsOf
parameters.description: Inclusive cutoff date (YYYY-MM-DD). Only assignments graded on or before this date are included in term-to-date progress.

get.summary: Get subject performance breakdown for all students in a class

get.description: Returns every student in the class with their point-weighted aggregated assignment score (total earned ÷ total possible), rank, and performance cluster for a given subject and term. Only assignments graded on or before aggregatedAsOf (YYYY-MM-DD) are included when that query param is set. Clusters are derived from the school grading system bands (not class rank). Also includes summary stats (average, median, highest, lowest), aggregation metadata, and cluster distribution counts. Supports optional filtering by cluster name and score range.

parameters.name: subjectCatalogId
parameters.description: UUID of the subject catalog entry

parameters.name: aggregatedAsOf
parameters.description: Inclusive cutoff date (YYYY-MM-DD). Only assignments graded on or before this date are included in term-to-date progress.

info.title: School Management API
info.description: OpenAPI spec for Postman and other clients

token.description: Confirmation token from the confirm-child email

academicTermId.description: Academic term the payment should apply to first

classScore.description: Omit or null when score not entered yet

examScore.description: Omit or null when score not entered yet

overrideGrade.description: Manual grade override when enabled by school

forceSubmit.description: When true, submit even if some students have missing scores

mobileNumber.description: Customer's mobile money number in international format (e.g. 233249111411)

targetFeeStructureId.description: Optional fee structure id to prioritise during allocation when payment is fulfilled

targetStudentFeeObligationId.description: Optional student fee obligation id (specific period line); takes precedence for allocation

identifier.description: Generated studentId, or email only if it belongs to exactly one school
Generated teacherId, or email only if it belongs to exactly one school

academicTermId.description: Academic term UUID (must belong to the school)

subjectId.description: Subject UUID - omit for school-wide note

academicTermId.description: Academic term UUID — scopes the note to a term (recommended when topics are reused across terms)
Academic term UUID — omit for a reusable (term-agnostic) curriculum; subtopic progress stays per term via completions
Academic term UUID (must belong to the school)

sourceAcademicTermId.description: Academic term to copy topics from

targetAcademicTermId.description: Academic term to create duplicated topics in

duplicateAllFromSource.description: When true, duplicate every topic whose effective term is the source term. Do not send topicIds.

topicIds.description: Topic UUIDs to copy. Required unless duplicateAllFromSource is true.

academicTermId.description: Academic term UUID, or null to unlink (term-agnostic curriculum)

schoolId.description: Catalog school id to invite into

email.description: Corrected recipient address; omit to resend as invited

clientId.description: Hubtel API client id (Basic Auth username)

clientSecret.description: Hubtel API client secret (Basic Auth password)

collectionAccountNumber.description: School's Hubtel Collection Account Number (used in URL path; determines settlement merchant)

active.description: Whether the merchant configuration is active and may receive payments

allowUssdPayment.description: If false, parents cannot pay this fee via USSD; Hubtel balance and allocation skip it.

activate.description: When true, activate immediately after create
